title: Pricing structure transition: launch orchestration and release notes coordination
creator: Owen Patel
description:
Summary: Coordinate the cross-functional launch of the new pricing structure (tier consolidation + revised limits and metering changes). This ticket owns the orchestration plan for launch day/week, release notes and changelog edits, consumer-facing billing communications, and the sales enablement package.

Goals:
- Ship an aligned launch plan that minimizes billing surprises for existing customers and provides clear migration paths.
- Ensure release notes are accurate, searchable, and linked to billing FAQ and migration guide.
- Equip sales and CS with playbooks, objection-handling, and margin impact calculators.
- Complete all gating tasks (billing migration QA, legal sign-off on TOS changes, console UI copy updates).

Scope (deliverables):
- Final release notes copy and changelog entry for public docs and Console announcement.
- Billing communications cadence: in-product banners, transactional emails, and targeted account emails.
- Sales enablement kit: one-pager, pitch deck slide, FAQ, migration cost calculator spreadsheet, and internal training script.
- Operational runbook for billing migrations and support escalation.
- Post-launch monitoring dashboard and success metrics defined.

Timeline & major milestones:
- 2026-02-10: PRD and migration policy approved (complete).
- 2026-02-18: Draft release notes + billing copy ready for review.
- 2026-02-24: Legal & Finance sign-off on comms and TOS updates.
- 2026-03-01: Sales enablement materials draft and enablement session scheduled.
- 2026-03-08: Final QA on billing migrations (staging run), docs freeze.
- 2026-03-15: Launch window (target) — public release and support on-call.

Rollout approach and risk mitigations:
- Staged rollout by account tier: internal beta (engineering/support + a few strategic customers) -> broader early access -> full public rollout.
- Billing migration simulator run in staging to validate invoice generation and quota enforcement.
- Pre-authorized rollback plan: revert metering gates and re-apply old limits via feature flag if critical billing regressions observed.
- Customer-impact communications templates ready for high/medium/low impact cohorts.

Release notes coordination specifics:
- Canonical release notes will live in docs.redwood.ai/pricing-changelog and be linked from Console release banner.
- Change summary required in three lengths: 1-sentence (banner), 2-paragraph (email), full detailed section (docs).
- Add explicit migration examples for typical account types (startup, scale, enterprise) and sample invoices.
- Include a clear what-changed table and a date-based effective policy block.

Cross-team task matrix (owners):
- Product (Maya Singh): finalize messaging, approve enablement kit, coordinate go/no-go.
- Engineering (ENG-2381 owner): ensure billing pipeline changes merged and tested; provide staging invoice logs.
- Finance: validate pricing math, SKU mapping and downstream revenue recognition implications.
- Legal: review TOS and customer notif copy.
- Developer Experience / Docs: publish release notes, update API docs and SDK changelog.
- Sales & CS: review enablement materials and attend training.
- Support: confirm on-call rotation and escalation runbook.

Success metrics (post-launch 30/60 days):
- <2% of invoices require manual correction for migration-related reasons.
- <5% spike in support tickets per 1k customers attributable to pricing changes.
- Sales team NPS on enablement >= 8/10 in post-launch survey.
- Migration opt-in rate for early-access cohort >= 70%.

Acceptance criteria (definition of done):
- Release notes published and linked in Console.
- Billing migration validated in staging with sample invoices generated for all tiers.
- Sales enablement kit delivered and at least one recorded training completed.
- Legal and Finance sign-offs recorded in the launch checklist.

Notes on communication cadence:
- Internal launch kick at +7d and +2d before release with status updates to #pm-pricing and #go-to-market.
- Customer-facing email schedule: 14d preview (targeted), 3d reminder (all affected), day-of notice (all affected), post-launch follow-up with migration help.

Known open questions & blockers:
- Determine final SKU mapping for legacy accounts that have custom bundles (Finance to propose mapping by 2026-02-22).
- Decision required: whether to grandfather existing committed-rate contracts or move them to equivalent new SKUs (Legal & Sales input due 2026-02-24).
- Engineering needs additional time for edge-case invoice formatting (ENG-2381 estimate increased; potential slip to 2026-03-05).
